title: District Collector's Inquiry into Consumer Complaints

content.scenario: A consumer in Mumbai files a complaint with the District Collector regarding a false advertisement by a local company. The District Collector receives the complaint and decides to investigate the matter.
content.outcome: The District Collector inquires into the complaint, investigates the matter within his jurisdiction, and submits a report to the Central Authority. The report highlights the company's violation of consumer rights and recommends necessary actions.

user_queries: What is the role of the District Collector in consumer protection?
How does the District Collector handle consumer complaints?
What happens after the District Collector submits a report to the Central Authority?
